description: Offline-first personal task workflow PWA built with Angular 19, Supabase, IndexedDB, GoJS, Parking Dock, Focus Mode, and Android widget support.
rules: Treat docs/context7 as the canonical machine-readable documentation corpus.
Use docs/context7/index.md as the root documentation entry point, equivalent to the Next.js docs index route.
Every Markdown page under docs/context7 must include metadata with title, status, audience, last_verified, and source_paths.
Route implementation questions through docs/context7/source-map.md and docs/context7/reference/service-catalog.md before choosing files.
Use docs/context7/contracts/*.md to preserve sync, security, and UI lifecycle invariants.
Use docs/context7/runbooks/*.md for operational debugging and recovery procedures.
Use docs/context7/reference/*.md for exact constants, field names, service ownership, and Supabase schema facts.
Use numbered sections docs/context7/01-getting-started through docs/context7/08-migration to mirror Next.js-style discoverability and ordering.
Maintain API reference, file conventions, error reference, examples, migration, and versioning pages for extensibility comparable to /vercel/next.js.
All persisted entity IDs are client-generated strings; new entities use crypto.randomUUID().
NanoFlow is offline-first: write locally, update UI immediately, debounce cloud sync, and queue failed writes for retry.
Use Last-Write-Wins conflict handling based on updatedAt/updated_at and preserve soft deletes through deletedAt/deleted_at tombstones.
Supabase queries that load tasks must include content, attachments, parking_meta, attention_meta, and updated_at fields.
Do not introduce NgRx, Redux, RxJS Store, or facade store aggregators; use Angular Signals and the concrete TaskStore, ProjectStore, and ConnectionStore.
Mobile defaults to Text view; GoJS Flow view must be lazy-loaded and destroyed/recreated instead of hidden with a live diagram.
Tree traversal must be iterative and respect FLOATING_TREE_CONFIG.MAX_SUBTREE_DEPTH = 100.
Secrets and third-party API keys must stay in Supabase Secrets or deployment environment variables; never hard-code them in frontend code.

When updating architecture, sync, data model, security, or workflow behavior, update the matching docs/context7 guide, reference page, contract, runbook, schema, and ADR when applicable, then run npm run docs:context7:validate.
